subject: Post-call: micro-batching, prefix cache & budget anchors (Velonet)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi.m@velonet.com>, Velonet Procurement <procurement@velonet.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-06T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: micro-batching, prefix cache & budget anchors (Velonet)

Hi Ravi / procurement team — thanks for the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and a proposed pilot framing so procurement can evaluate the budget fit.

Call summary (30m):
- Primary pain: unpredictable token spend during peak marketing prompts + sporadic 95th-pctl latency spikes that impact user experience.
- Secondary constraint: procurement needs a clear 30–60 day pilot price band and telemetry access for throughput/latency before any commit.
- Compliance note: Velonet needs evidence for SOC 2 and network isolation options (VPC) — Grace will surface the exact artifacts after you confirm.

Goals you stated:
- Reduce per-conversation token spend by ~40–60% without impacting prompt fidelity.
- Keep 95th-pctl inference latency < 300ms for the majority of interactive traffic.
- Pilot must fit inside a Q3 discretionary spend window (~$100–150k).

Cost levers and our recommended approach (short):
1) Micro-batching + adaptive flush windows — batch small, frequent groups (~8–16 reqs) during steady state to preserve latency while giving batch savings at peak. Expected token-cost reduction: 20–35% vs naive single-request serving.
2) Prefix/KV caching for repeated system prompts — we estimate 10–25% token savings for your conversational flows where the user prompt shares a stable system prefix.
3) Quantization (int8) on dedicated nodes for embeddings and sampling-heavy calls — 15–25% lower GPU cost in Dedicated mode.
4) Smart routing: route low-priority background scoring to a cheaper model variant and keep interactive traffic on the lower-latency instance types.

Pilot sizing (proposal):
- Duration: 30 days controlled roll (can extend to 60).
- Scoped traffic: 100k user conversations / month projected; average request = 420 tokens (prompt + response).
- Band scenarios (approx net spend for pilot window):
  • Status quo (no changes): ~$48k month (baseline cloud serving).
  • With micro-batching + prefix cache: ~$31k month (35% improvement).
  • Dedicated reserved-mini (1 w/ burst): ~$24k month amortized (requires small reserved commit).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Ravi: confirm the Q3 pilot budget band (we used $100–150k as discussed). If procurement needs a narrower band, tell us the target and we’ll optimize scope.
- Procurement: please share preferred PO cadence and any SOW redline owners so we can prepare the 1-page SOW.
- Internal: Ben / Grace — I attached the sizing workbook and one-pager. Grace, can you collate SOC 2 + VPC/network checklist once Ravi confirms?

Attached: velonet-pilot-sizing.xlsx (workbook with traffic scenarios) and micro-batching-ops-onepager.pdf (ops implications + telemetry hooks).

I'll follow up with a short pricing note and a HubSpot deal link inside 24 hours. Thanks again — Marcus

--

Subject: Re: Post-call: micro-batching, prefix cache & budget anchors (Velonet)

Thanks Marcus — helpful summary. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

1) Our Q3 discretionary window is firm near $120k (upper bound). The org will consider pilot spend inside that envelope but needs a clear top-line not-to-exceed amount for 30 days.
2) We need per-conversation cost guidance (USD/conversation) across the three scenarios you listed, and an explanation of how the hybrid dedicated pricing would be billed if we exceed the amortized allocation.
3) Telemetry: we need read-only telemetry access into latency and token breakdowns (per-route) for engineering to validate your 95th-pctl claims. Do you provide Grafana dashboards or a datadump?
4) Compliance: please send SOC 2 Type II evidence and the VPC on-boarding doc.

If you can get the per-conversation numbers and a TOE (top-of-envelope) not-to-exceed for 30 days, procurement will review and get back within 48 hours. We can schedule a pricing review with Ben and your team after that.

-Ravi
Head of ML Products, Velonet
ravim@velonet.com

Date: 2027-06-07T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: micro-batching, prefix cache & budget anchors (Velonet)

Ravi — appreciate the quick reply. Quick answers and next actions below.

Per-conversation guidance (30-day pilot, controlled traffic):
- Status quo: ~$0.48 / conversation (baseline cloud-hosted inference, no batching/caching).
- Micro-batching + prefix cache: ~$0.31 / conversation (our conservative scenario, assumes 30% token reduction and same latency SLO).
- Dedicated reserved-mini: ~$0.24 / conversation (amortized committed capacity + micro-batching; this requires a small monthly reserved commitment — we model it so pilot stays within the $120k band).

Not-to-exceed math (30 days):
- Conservative pilot (we'll size for 100k conversations):
  • Status quo: 100k * $0.48 = $48k
  • With micro-batching: 100k * $0.31 = $31k
  • Dedicated amortized: 100k * $0.24 = $24k (plus a small reserved fee; see workbook tab "reserved-model")

Billing notes: if you exceed the amortized allocation in Dedicated, overages are billed at a step-down usage rate (we'll share the exact rate card in the quote). We can set hard-cost caps during the pilot to avoid surprises.

Telemetry: we provide a Grafana view and periodic CSV exports with per-request token breakdown, model variant used, and latency percentiles. Grace will share onboarding steps for read-only access.

Compliance: Grace — can you attach SOC 2 Type II and the VPC checklist now?

Next steps (proposed):
1) Marcus: send a 1-page pilot SOW and a HubSpot deal link (within 24 hours) — DONE (link above).
2) Procurement: confirm PO cadence and whether we should route through an MSSP.
3) Technical sync (Ben + Velonet eng) to agree on telemetry metrics and routing rules — propose Thu 6/10 10:00am PT.

If that works, I'll draft the short SOW and the DocuSign link for the pilot.

Thanks — Marcus

Attachments: velonet-pilot-sizing.xlsx (updated: "reserved-model" tab includes amortization and overage rates)
